summary: Evernorth Holdings filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing a clerical correction to share counts issued at the October 9, 2026 close of its business combination with Armada Acquisition Corp. II, plus a new Chief Investment Officer appointment. Delayed funding subscribers received 1,078,613 Class A shares, not 663,510, priced at $10.00 per share. Post-closing there are 23,638,882 Class A and 31,392,746 Class C shares outstanding; the Sponsor holds 92.5% of Class C stock. Watch the share-count overhang and any further restatement risk.
